issue.title: [NEXT-1242] Server Action will freeze the Client app

issue.body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
> servicedesk@0.1.0 info
> next info
    Operating System:
      Platform: win32
      Arch: x64
      Version: Windows 10 Pro
    Binaries:
      Node: 18.16.0
      npm: N/A
      Yarn: N/A
      pnpm: N/A
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.4.4-canary.13
      eslint-config-next: N/A
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: 5.0.4
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

_No response_

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/vibrant-scooby-t51sd3

### To Reproduce

`wait.tsx`
```typescript
"use server";
export const async wait_some(ms: number) => new Promise((res) => useTimeout(() => res(), ms));
```

`button.tsx`
```typescript
"use client";

export default async Button = () => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState<boolean>(false);
  const wait_a_bit = async () => {
    setLoading(true);    
    await wait_some(2000);
    setLoading(false);
  }
  return <button onClick={wait_a_bit}>Freeze me</button>
}
```

This will freeze the frontent app in the current next release

### Describe the Bug

When doing any state updates on the frontend while a server action is invoked the whole ui freezes and stays frozen. This example uses useState Hook, but this also happens with useTransition etc.

### Expected Behavior

Not Freeze :)

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

chrome latest

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

_No response_

issue.body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:

      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: 5.1.3
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

App directory (appDir: true), Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link)

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug

https://github.com/andrewmcoupe/server-actions-blocking-navigation

### To Reproduce

Visit the deployed version [here](https://server-actions-blocking-navigation.vercel.app/).

## Happy path with route handlers

1. Fill out the name field in the first form.
2. Submit the form.
3. Navigate to the profile page via the link at the top of the page.
4. Navigation works 🎉 

## Unhappy path with server actions

1. Fill out the name field in the **second** form.
2. Submit the form.
3. Navigate to the profile page via the link at the top of the page.
4. Navigation is broken 😢 

### Describe the Bug

Server actions block navigation whilst the request is pending/in-flight.

https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/24691226/fe502f0d-78bf-4358-88e9-b82bde489cd4



### Expected Behavior

Navigation should work whilst a request using server actions is pending. It should replicate the same behaviour as route handlers i.e not block navigation.

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

Arc Version 0.106.1 (39259) Chromium Engine Version 114.0.5735.45

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

Vercel

body: is there any solution for this problem?

issue.title: fix: server actions blocking navigation events
issue.body:
A long-running server action shouldn't block page navigation. This makes use of a global mutable to detect when a navigation event occurs -- this change will unblock other reducers (such as navigation).

If we bailed on the action, we trigger a `router.refresh()` to ensure any side effects from the action are refetched.

Closes NEXT-1131
Fixes #49425

upgrading to v13.4.20-canary.1 has introduced the following bug - when there is a long server action, the first server action re-loops, reruns again and again. Specifically I'm running googleapis library from my server action, calling multiple server actions which altogether might take almost a minute, had to stay in 13.4.20-canary.0.
@eifo are you able to open a separate issue with a minimal reproduction? That'll make it easier for us to triage/follow-up with a fix 🙏
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for 2 weeks. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.
